Class TypeOperations

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.TypeOperations
@Internal public final class TypeOperations extends Object
The operations on the types of the model that the hierarchy walk, override resolution and the generators share: unwrapping annotations, raw types, erasure, substitution, walking the variables a type names, expanding chains of bounds, and a type as one of its supertypes.

Each operation is defined once here, so that the places reading a type agree on what it erases to or which variables it names.

Since:
2.3

    • erase

      public static TypeDef erase(TypeDef type, Function<String, @Nullable TypeDef> declared, @Nullable ClassTypeDef thisType)
      Erases a type (JLS 4.6). A variable is the erasure of its leftmost bound - Object for T extends Object & Comparable<T>, as the bytecode writers describe it - taken from the reference where it carries its bounds, else from its declaration in scope. A variable bounded by itself through others - A extends B and B extends A - erases to Object. A parameterized type is its class, without the enclosing type a member carries; a wildcard is the erasure of its upper bound; and an array keeps its rank with its component erased.
      Parameters:
      type - The type
      declared - The leftmost bound of a variable in scope by its name, or null where it declares none
      thisType - The type TypeDef.THIS stands for, or null to keep it
      Returns:
      The erased type

    • expandBounds

      public static List<TypeDef> expandBounds(TypeDef.TypeVariable variable, Function<TypeDef.TypeVariable, @Nullable TypeDef.TypeVariable> declaration)
      Expands the bounds of a variable: each bound that is itself a variable in scope is replaced by that variable's bounds, along a chain of any length - U extends V with V extends Number is bounded by Number. A variable reached again along the chain ends it.
      Parameters:
      variable - The variable
      declaration - The variable in scope a reference stands for, with the bounds it is declared with, or null for one that is not expanded, and is a bound itself
      Returns:
      The bounds that are not expanded, as they are declared, in declaration order
